# Pacific Lutheran University

> > Pacific Lutheran University (PLU) is a private university in the Pacific Northwest offering undergraduate, graduate, and international programs with a Lutheran heritage of service.

PLU serves students from Washington State (including Running Start and community college transfer students), international students, and graduate learners. The university emphasizes academic excellence, NCAA Division III athletics, and lives of service in the Tacoma area.

## Key Topics

- Pacific Lutheran University (PLU)
- Running Start programs
- Transfer credits and AA-DTA pathways
- International student admissions
- Graduate programs (MBA, MEd, MFA)
- Tacoma Community College (TCC) partnerships
- Presidential Scholarships
- NCAA Division III athletics
- Campus life and residence halls
- Study abroad opportunities
- Lutheran heritage and service-learning
- Washington State community college transfers
- Advanced standing and credit policies
- BAS to MBA pathways
- Pacific Northwest location

## Admissions

- [Graduate Programs | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-graduate): Main graduate programs page featuring MBA, MEd, MFA, and other degrees
- [Cost & Scholarship | International | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-international/cost-scholarship): International student tuition costs, scholarships, and financial aid info
- [Campus Life | First-Year | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-first-year/campus-life): First-year student life including residence halls, athletics, and clubs
- [Explore | First-Year | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-first-year/explore): First-year exploration page covering campus life and study abroad options
- [Running Start Students | First-Year | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-first-year/apply/running-start-students): Washington State Running Start admission info for first-year students
- [Athletics | First-Year | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-first-year/campus-life/lute-pride): NCAA Division III athletics and varsity sports programs at PLU

## Transfer Pathways & Credit Policies

- [TCC to PLU | Graduate Programs | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-graduate/bas-to-plu/tcc-to-plu): Tacoma Community College BAS to PLU graduate program transfer pathway
- [International Advance Credit Policies | International | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-international/apply/international-advance-credit-policies): IB, Cambridge, and GAC advance credit policies for international students

## International Students

- [Lives of Service | International | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-international/why-plu/lives-of-service): Lutheran heritage and service-learning values for international students

## Student Resources & Support

- [Student Resources | Graduate Programs | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admission-graduate/student-resources): Graduate student resources including calendar, catalog, and scheduling
- [Verificación | Oficina de Admisión | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/admision-espanol/verification): Spanish FAFSA verification process and federal requirements info
- [Entire Class | Access Administration | PLU](https://www.plu.edu/access/request-access/entire-class): Class access request form for DOARs using CRN numbers
